paragraphs: From the Tipperary test centre on Main Street, move off and drive along Main Street for about 60 metres
Take the 1st right, still on Main Street take the next left to continue on Main Street for around 100 metres
Bear slight right to stay on the road through Tipperary town
Turn left onto Father Matthew Street and follow it for just over 200 metres
Take the next left to stay on Father Matthew Street
The road name changes to James Connolly Park and then Lake Lands as you continue straight through this residential stretch, so keep an eye on your speed and watch for parked cars and pedestrians
At the end of the road turn right onto Rosanna Road
Take the next right into a side road you will be asked to complete a turnabout here, so pull in safely, prepare, and perform a U-turn using the width of the road
Head back out and turn left onto Rosanna Road, following it for roughly 800 metres
Turn left onto the R497 take the next right onto Tipperary West Urban
Turn left into a quiet side road for another turnabout exercise, complete your U-turn
Turn left back onto Tipperary West Urban turn right, then at the end of the road turn right onto the Limerick Road
Take the next left onto Tipperary West Urban and then the next left onto a narrow country road
Follow this rural road for around 1.7 kilometres, staying well left and watching for oncoming traffic on the bends
Take the sharp right, continue to the end of the road and turn right
Follow the road straight ahead as the name changes
This is a good stretch to practice smooth gear changes and steady progress on a country road
Coming back into town, bear slight left onto Davis Street and turn left onto Main Street
Take the next left, then a slight left into a side road for one more manoeuvre
After the exercise, retrace by taking the 1st right
Left, then a slight right, and turn right onto Father Matthew Street
Continue straight as it becomes Main Street turn right onto Davis Street, and bear slight right onto Murgasty Road before pulling in on the left back at the Tipperary test centre
